verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on a WorkOS workspace, reading and changing dashboard data through the WorkOS API, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. AuthKit's support for securing your own MCP server is a separate building block and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented connection and auth setup steps for agent clients, an enumerated tool list, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The WorkOS MCP server is a remote management Model Context Protocol server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on your WorkOS workspace.
Once connected, your agent can read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more) by calling the WorkOS API on your behalf.
official MCP server documented at https://workos.com/docs/mcp
